intro: Winter's Presents is an Alliance holiday breadcrumb quest celebrating the Feast of Winter Veil in Ironforge. Joyful revelers and PX-238 Wonderform Operators urge travelers to visit Greatfather Winter beside the Smokywood Pastures market stalls. There, beneath the grand holiday tree, festive gifts await hearty adventurers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear Greatfather Winter - with the generous support of Smokeywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Ironforge. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.
But you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Greatfather Winter has some presents with your name on them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, ho hello there! You can only be here for one reason: to open your Winter Veil presents.
Now, don't you worry, Greatfather Winter hasn't forgotten about his favorite traveler adventurer. Look under the tree and you'll find your gifts.
During this season of giving, perhaps your friends would also enjoy receiving some of Smokeywood Pasture's excellent products?
